_comment: Provider registry. Prices are list prices per 1M tokens, read from each vendor's public pricing page on the date below. Cache-hit and batch discounts are NOT modelled — the cost column reflects an uncached request. Corrections by PR are merged fast.

_sources.official-moonshot: Moonshot international API — kimi-k3 listed at $3.00 (input, cache miss) / $15.00 (output) per 1M; $0.30 on cache hit. The domestic CN endpoint (platform.moonshot.cn) is a separate price list in CNY (¥20 / ¥100).
_sources.openrouter: https://openrouter.ai/models — figures as listed on the model table
_sources.gloritoken: https://gloritoken.ai — prices updated 2026-08-05 (Kimi K3 cut to $1.73/$8.65; Qwen 3.8 Max $1.04/$3.11)

_fx._note: For providers that publish in a currency other than USD. Set "currency" on a model entry and its list price is converted for the cost column at the rate below, with the conversion disclosed in the output. Override at runtime, e.g. FX_CNY_USD=0.1395. No provider currently in this registry needs it — every one below publishes in USD.

official-moonshot.label: Moonshot (official)
official-moonshot.note: International endpoint and its USD price list. Cache hits cost $0.30 per 1M input instead of $3.00; this tool always measures an uncached request. Moonshot's domestic CN endpoint is a different endpoint with a different price list (¥20 / ¥100 per 1M) — if that is what you use, change baseUrl and prices accordingly.

official-deepseek.label: DeepSeek (official)
official-deepseek.note: Cache-miss pricing. A cache hit costs $0.003625 per 1M input on v4-pro, which this tool does not exercise.

openrouter.label: OpenRouter
openrouter.note: Routes to third-party hosts; build, quantization and throughput vary by host. Buying credits carries a fee on top of the listed rate, which is not included below.

gloritoken.label: gloritoken
gloritoken.note: Maintainer of this tool. Included as one provider among others; results are printed exactly as measured.
